--- title: "Store dataframes in a list by alignment in polars" subtitle: "pl.align_frames" author: '{{< var author >}}' date: '2025-10-03' date-format: iso toc: true toc-title: 'Sections' toc-location: right toc-depth: 3 categories: [100DaysOfPolars] --- You have two dataframes and want to store them in a list based on shared values in one column. Below are two dataframes; one with movie ratings and the other with duration. **Movie rating dataframe** ::: {#2cafbb07 .cell execution_count=1} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ```{=html}
shape: (4, 2)
MovieRating
strf64
"Inception"8.8
"The Revenant"8.0
"The Wolf of Wall Street"8.2
"Revolutionary Road"7.3
``` ::: ::: **Movie duration dataframe** ::: {#25da7f42 .cell execution_count=2} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ```{=html}
shape: (4, 2)
MovieDuration
stri64
"The Fall Guy"126
"The Revenant"156
"La La Land"128
"Revolutionary Road"119
``` ::: ::: ## Align dataframes and store in list To create a list of dataframes that contain movies featuring Leonardo DiCaprio, you can use the Polars expression `pl.align_frames` like this: ::: {#bfca399c .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} aligned_dfs = (pl.align_frames(rating_df, duration_df, on='Movie', how='inner') ) aligned_dfs ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` [shape: (2, 2) ┌────────────────────┬────────┐ │ Movie ┆ Rating │ │ --- ┆ --- │ │ str ┆ f64 │ ╞════════════════════╪════════╡ │ Revolutionary Road ┆ 7.3 │ │ The Revenant ┆ 8.0 │ └────────────────────┴────────┘, shape: (2, 2) ┌────────────────────┬──────────┐ │ Movie ┆ Duration │ │ --- ┆ --- │ │ str ┆ i64 │ ╞════════════════════╪══════════╡ │ Revolutionary Road ┆ 119 │ │ The Revenant ┆ 156 │ └────────────────────┴──────────┘] ``` ::: ::: Now that you have a list of dataframes, you can access any one of them by index. For example, to get the first dataframe, do this: ::: {#5ff1e5ec .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} aligned_dfs[0] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ```{=html}
shape: (2, 2)
MovieRating
strf64
"Revolutionary Road"7.3
"The Revenant"8.0
``` ::: ::: Notice that this movie rating dataframe is not the same as the original. This one only contains movies in which Leonardo DiCaprio appeared. Enroll in my {{< var polars_course >}} and have the time of your life learning!
